prompt: How do I set up a plugin marketplace so my team automatically gets our plugins when they open the repo, and how do versioning and updates actually work? We push changes often.
assertions: Explains the marketplace catalog file at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
Shows extraKnownMarketplaces (and enabledPlugins) in project .claude/settings.json so teammates are auto-prompted when they trust the repo
States that an explicit version in plugin.json must be bumped on every release or users won't receive updates
Given frequent pushes, recommends omitting version so the git commit SHA is used and every commit counts as an update
Mentions /plugin marketplace update (or auto-update) to refresh the marketplace
